Gradient boosting in slow motion: each n.src: Gradient boosting in slow motion: each new tree fits the residual of the previous ensemble. Click Add tree; watch the prediction sharpen and the loss drop. Then see why the second-order (Newton) update XGBoost actually uses beats the vanilla first-order one.

Build a sequence of weak learners (small.zh: 构建一系列弱学习器（小树），每一棵都拟合当前预测的残差。集成预测是所有树之和。

Build a sequence of weak learners (small trees), each
          fitting the residual of the running prediction. The

$\\eta$ is the learning rate. Smaller $\.zh: $\eta$ 是学习率。在给定预算下，较小的 $\eta$ 加更多的树几乎总是优于较大的 $\eta$ 加更少的树。$f_t$ 是第 $t$ 棵树在输入 $x$ 上的输出。
$\\eta$ is the learning rate. Smaller $\.src:
$\eta$ is the learning rate. Smaller $\eta$ + more trees is
          almost always better than larger $\eta$ + fewer trees, up to
          a budget. $f_t$ is what tree $t$ outputs on input $x$.

Vanilla gradient boosting fits $f_t$ to.src: Vanilla gradient boosting fits $f_t$ to the negative gradient $-\partial L / \partial \hat y$ (a first-order approximation). XGBoost (Chen & Guestrin, 2016) does a second-order Taylor expansion and fits the tree to optimise the Newton-step direction. Its split-gain and leaf-value formulas are:

where $g_i = \\partial L / \\partial \\h.zh: 其中 $g_i = \partial L / \partial \hat y_i$，$h_i = \partial^2 L / \partial \hat y_i^2$。对于平方损失 $L = \frac{1}{2}(y - \hat y)^2$，这退化为朴素的 GBM（$g = \hat y - y$，$h = 1$）。对于逻辑损失，XGBoost 顾及 Hessian 的更新收敛速度明显更快。
where $g_i = \\partial L / \\partial \\h.src:
where $g_i = \partial L / \partial \hat y_i$ and
          $h_i = \partial^2 L / \partial \hat y_i^2$. For squared loss
          $L = \frac{1}{2}(y - \hat y)^2$ this reduces to vanilla GBM
          ($g = \hat y - y$, $h = 1$). For logistic loss XGBoost's
          Hessian-aware update converges meaningfully faster.

A 1-D regression toy with a hidden curve.src: A 1-D regression toy with a hidden curve. Click Add tree; the next tree fits the current residual; the ensemble prediction (teal) updates. Compare to a single deep tree and a random forest of 25 trees on the same data.

@@T0@@The first tree is just a step func.zh:
@@T0@@第一棵树只是一个阶梯函数。@@T1@@
            深度为 3 意味着至多 8 个叶节点；预测是对真实函数的块状近似。
@@T0@@The first tree is just a step func.src: The first tree is just a step function. Depth-3 means at most 8 leaves; the prediction is a blocky approximation of the truth.

@@T0@@Each subsequent tree corrects the.zh:
@@T0@@其后每一棵树都修正残差。@@T1@@
            观察残差面板：它变得更具噪声也更小，除非你持续添加树，否则永远无法真正达到零。
@@T0@@Each subsequent tree corrects the.src: Each subsequent tree corrects the residual. Watch the residual panel: it gets noisier and smaller, never really hitting zero unless you keep adding trees.

@@T0@@Lower η = smoother fits.@@T1@@ At.zh: @@T0@@较低的 η = 更平滑的拟合。@@T1@@ 在 η=0.05 加 100 棵树时曲线平滑。在 η=0.5 加 20 棵树时则参差不齐。总的「步长」相同，偏差/方差的权衡不同。
@@T0@@Lower η = smoother fits.@@T1@@ At.src: Lower η = smoother fits. At η=0.05 + 100 trees the curve is smooth. At η=0.5 + 20 trees it's jagged. Same total "step size", different bias/variance.

@@T0@@Boosted vs RF.@@T1@@ Random forest.zh: @@T0@@提升法与随机森林对比。@@T1@@ 随机森林对许多 @@T2@@相互独立@@T3@@ 的深树取平均；提升法则构建 @@T4@@相互依赖@@T5@@ 的浅树。随机森林稳健且可并行；提升法更准确但需串行。自 2018 年以来，在表格任务上 XGBoost / LightGBM / CatBoost 在大多数基准中胜过随机森林。
@@T0@@Boosted vs RF.@@T1@@ Random forest.src: Boosted vs RF. Random forest averages many independent deep trees; boosting builds dependent shallow trees. RF is robust + parallel; boosting is more accurate + sequential. For tabular tasks XGBoost / LightGBM / CatBoost beat RF on most benchmarks since 2018.

Production XGBoost — what to actually tu.zh: 生产环境中的 XGBoost —— 真正该调什么
Production XGBoost — what to actually tu.src: Production XGBoost — what to actually tune

@@T0@@n_estimators / num_boost_round.@@T.zh: @@T0@@n_estimators / num_boost_round。@@T1@@ 配合验证集使用早停。500–5000 是有用的范围；更多则是浪费。
@@T0@@n_estimators / num_boost_round.@@T.src: n_estimators / num_boost_round. Use early stopping with a validation set. 500–5000 is the useful range; more is wasted.

@@T0@@learning_rate (η).@@T1@@ 0.01–0.1.zh: @@T0@@learning_rate (η)。@@T1@@ 大数据集用 0.01–0.1，小数据集用 0.05–0.3。树更多时取更低值。
@@T0@@learning_rate (η).@@T1@@ 0.01–0.1.src: learning_rate (η). 0.01–0.1 for big datasets, 0.05–0.3 for small. Lower with more trees.

@@T0@@max_depth.@@T1@@ 3–10. Deeper for.zh: @@T0@@max_depth。@@T1@@ 3–10。对于交互丰富的大型表格数据可更深；对于噪声数据则更浅。
@@T0@@max_depth.@@T1@@ 3–10. Deeper for.src: max_depth. 3–10. Deeper for big tabular data with rich interactions; shallower for noisy data.

@@T0@@min_child_weight.@@T1@@ Equivalent.zh: @@T0@@min_child_weight。@@T1@@ 相当于按 Hessian 加权的每叶最小样本数。默认值为 1；对噪声数据可调高。
@@T0@@min_child_weight.@@T1@@ Equivalent.src: min_child_weight. Equivalent of min-samples-per-leaf weighted by the Hessian. 1 default; push higher for noisy data.

@@T0@@subsample / colsample_bytree.@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@subsample / colsample_bytree。@@T1@@ 每棵树的行 / 特征自助采样。0.7–0.9 是最佳区间 —— 引入随机性，起到正则化作用。
@@T0@@subsample / colsample_bytree.@@T1@.src: subsample / colsample_bytree. Bootstrap row / feature sampling per tree. 0.7–0.9 is the sweet spot — adds randomness, regularises.

@@T0@@reg_alpha / reg_lambda.@@T1@@ L1 /.zh: @@T0@@reg_alpha / reg_lambda。@@T1@@ 作用于叶权重的 L1 / L2 正则。若你的特征很多且担心过拟合，可加以调校。
@@T0@@reg_alpha / reg_lambda.@@T1@@ L1 /.src: reg_alpha / reg_lambda. L1 / L2 on leaf weights. Tune if you have many features and worry about overfitting.

@@T0@@tree_method.@@T1@@ Use 'hist' (def.zh: @@T0@@tree_method。@@T1@@ 一切情况都使用 'hist'（现代 XGBoost 的默认值）；它比 'exact' 更快且同样准确。
@@T0@@tree_method.@@T1@@ Use 'hist' (def.src: tree_method. Use 'hist' (default in modern XGBoost) for everything; it's faster and as accurate as 'exact'.

@@T0@@monotonic constraints.@@T1@@ Force.zh: @@T0@@单调性约束。@@T1@@ 强制「预测必须对特征 X 单调」—— 在保险、医疗、监管场景中很有用。
@@T0@@monotonic constraints.@@T1@@ Force.src: monotonic constraints. Force "prediction must be monotone in feature X" — useful for insurance, healthcare, regulation.

@@T0@@missing values.@@T1@@ XGBoost nati.zh: @@T0@@缺失值。@@T1@@ XGBoost 会为每个分裂原生地学习 NaN 的最佳方向路由；除非必要，否则不要做插补。
@@T0@@missing values.@@T1@@ XGBoost nati.src: missing values. XGBoost natively learns best-direction routing for NaN per split; don't impute unless you must.

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n For t.zh:
@@T0@@一句口号。@@T1@@
          对于类型混杂、含缺失值且行数 $\le$ 数百万的表格数据，XGBoost / LightGBM / CatBoost 依然是最强大 @@T2@@也最简单@@T3@@ 的默认选择。神经表格模型（TabNet、FT-Transformer、SAINT）偶尔在基准中获胜；但在大多数生产场景中，梯度提升树仍然胜出。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n For t.src: The slogan. For tabular data with mixed types, missing values, and $\le$ a few million rows, XGBoost / LightGBM / CatBoost are still the strongest and simplest default. Neural-tabular models (TabNet, FT-Transformer, SAINT) win benchmarks occasionally; gradient-boosted trees still win most of the production time.

@@T0@@LightGBM.@@T1@@ Histogram-based; l.zh: @@T0@@LightGBM。@@T1@@ 基于直方图；按叶生长（优先最深）的分裂方式；在大数据上比 XGBoost 更快；稍易过拟合，但用 @@T2@@num_leaves@@T3@@ 和正则化即可轻松控制。
@@T0@@LightGBM.@@T1@@ Histogram-based; l.src: LightGBM. Histogram-based; leaf-wise (deepest-first) splitting; faster than XGBoost on big data; slightly more overfit-prone, easily controlled with num_leaves and regularisation.

@@T0@@CatBoost.@@T1@@ Native handling of.zh: @@T0@@CatBoost。@@T1@@ 原生处理类别特征（无泄漏的目标编码）；默认超参数极佳；在大数据上是三者中最慢的。
@@T0@@CatBoost.@@T1@@ Native handling of.src: CatBoost. Native handling of categorical features (target encoding without leakage); excellent default hyperparameters; slowest of the three on large data.

@@T0@@HistGradientBoosting (sklearn).@@T.zh: @@T0@@HistGradientBoosting（sklearn）。@@T1@@ 纯 Python 的替代方案；比最初的 sklearn GBM 快得多；精度相当；随 sklearn 一同提供。
@@T0@@HistGradientBoosting (sklearn).@@T.src: HistGradientBoosting (sklearn). Pure-Python alternative; much faster than the original sklearn GBM; comparable accuracy; ships with sklearn.

@@T0@@NGBoost.@@T1@@ Gradient boosting t.zh: @@T0@@NGBoost。@@T1@@ 输出一个 @@T2@@分布@@T3@@（均值 + 方差）的梯度提升；对下游的不确定性工作很有用。
@@T0@@NGBoost.@@T1@@ Gradient boosting t.src: NGBoost. Gradient boosting that outputs a distribution (mean + variance); useful for downstream uncertainty work.

@@T0@@XGBoost-Spark / Dask-XGBoost.@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@XGBoost-Spark / Dask-XGBoost。@@T1@@ 面向超大数据集的分布式实现。
@@T0@@XGBoost-Spark / Dask-XGBoost.@@T1@.src: XGBoost-Spark / Dask-XGBoost. Distributed for very large data.

@@T0@@TabNet, FT-Transformer, SAINT.@@T1.zh: @@T0@@TabNet、FT-Transformer、SAINT。@@T1@@ 神经表格模型的替代方案；有时胜出，常常打平，很少能证明额外的 ML-ops 复杂度是值得的。
@@T0@@TabNet, FT-Transformer, SAINT.@@T1.src: TabNet, FT-Transformer, SAINT. Neural tabular alternatives; sometimes win, often tie, rarely justify the extra ML-ops complexity.

meta.title: 逐棵树理解 XGBoost
meta.tagline: 每一棵新树都拟合上一棵的残差 —— 一次次点击，看回归曲线如何落定
meta.summary: 在一个一维玩具问题上进行实时的梯度提升回归。每次点击都会添加一棵拟合残差的新树；集成预测随之变清晰。配有学习率、最大深度与树数量的滑块。在同一目标上比较提升集成、单棵树与随机森林。此外还有 XGBoost 所用的精确梯度/Hessian 公式。
highlights: 点击「添加树」逐步走过提升轮次；观察残差缩小、预测逼近真实函数。
在同一数据上并排比较单棵树、随机森林与提升集成。
逐步的训练损失曲线；面向学习率、深度与树数量的超参数滑块。
XGBoost 的增益公式，以及它为何胜过朴素 GBM 的二阶牛顿视角。
